Your New Roommate

A downloadable game for Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android

Download NowName your own price

Your New Roommate is an exploration game where you can interact with Jeff the Killer and the things in his room. Get to know him a little.

⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘

Note: This game is currently a demo. I’m still not sure where I want the story to go, since I originally made it simply to practice my game development skills. It could eventually become some dating sim, a survival game, or just remain a simple exploration game. I’ll decide on the direction in the future, especially if there’s enough interest from players :)

If you want to contact me about anything, please refer to my strawpage linked on my profile <3
